title: schedule
description: Schedules an action to be executed once an area is loaded, or after a certain amount of time.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: An `enum` of either `append` to allow multiple schedules or `replace` to replace the default schedule.

delaymode.title: DelayMode
delaymode.description: An `enum` of either `append` to allow multiple schedules or `replace` to replace the default schedule.

from.title: from
from.description: A `vector` [x y z] that specifies the rectangular area to load, along with `to`.

to.title: to
to.description: A vector [x y z] that specifies the rectangular area to load, along with `from`.

center.title: center
center.description: A `vector` [x y z] that specifies the center of a defined loaded area.

radius.title: radius
radius.description: An `integer` that specifies the area as the number of chunks loaded in. Default: `0`.

name.title: name
name.description: A `string` that defines the `tickingarea` where the command is added.
